name: docker compose watch
description: Automatically sync, rebuild or restart services when source files change, based on the develop.watch section of compose.yaml.

flags.description: Do not build and start services before watching
Prune dangling images left by rebuilds
Hide build output

examples.description: Start the project and watch files, with sync/rebuild events separated from app logs
Start the project in watch mode with logs and watch events together

examples.command:
services:
  web:
    build: .
    develop:
      watch:
        - action: sync
          path: ./web
          target: /src/web
          ignore:
            - node_modules/
        - action: rebuild
          path: package.json
        - action: sync+restart
          path: ./nginx.conf
          target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
examples.description: develop.watch rules: sync source files, rebuild on dependency changes, sync and restart on config changes

notes: Actions: sync (copy files into the running container), rebuild (rebuild the image and recreate the container), sync+restart (copy then restart).
Watch only works for services built from local source (a build: section); the image needs a writable target and tools like stat/mkdir for sync.
